antifold_veto_rule.rule: delta_log_probability <= -3 and mutant rank among worst four of 20

qualification_layers.A_multi_metric: at least two moderate/strong favorable metrics; no moderate/strong adverse metric
qualification_layers.B_single_metric_strong: one strong favorable metric; other metrics weak/negligible
qualification_layers.C_single_metric_moderate: one moderate favorable metric; other metrics weak/negligible
qualification_layers.D_controlled_tradeoff: at least two moderate/strong favorable metrics and exactly one moderate adverse metric

selection_order: maximum three candidates per position; cover first, second, then third candidate per position; within each round use A>B>C>D, strong-positive count, positive count, fewer moderate adverse metrics, fewer soft sequence risks, stable-word gain, then candidate identifier
